tasks-from:
    - compiled.yml
    - marionette.yml
    - tests.yml

# These apply to all included test yml files listed in tasks-from
task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: ["hg", "git"]
    attributes:
        retrigger: true
    use-python: system
    use-uv: false
    optimization:
        by-test-platform:
            .*-tsan.*/opt:
                skip-unless-backstop: null
            .*-asan.*/opt:
                skip-unless-backstop: null
            default:
                never: null
    docker-image: {in-tree: ubuntu2404-test}
